content.title: Flagship-backed Omega signals it’s headed toward bankruptcy
content.summary: Flagship’s Pioneering Medicines initiative could acquire Omega’s assets via a stalking horse bid, according to a regulatory filing.

thumbnail.caption: Omega Therapeutics said in a Monday securities filing it was entering a restructuring agreement with Flagship Pioneering Medicines and would file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
